title: Load from an address
addressTip: The server downloads the file itself. Your device does not have to stay online for it.
fileNameTip: Comes from the address, you can change it. When the folder has the name already, the new file gets a number.
targetTip: The folder open in the active panel.
badUrl: That is no valid address. It starts with https:// or http://
badName: The file name is missing or holds a slash
noDir: This target folder does not exist
